items.headline: Best of Week 6: A Red River game winner and upsets galore in the SEC
items.description: With three top-10 ranked teams in the SEC losing, Week 6 had all the theatrics starting with Oklahoma's win.

items.headline: Kentucky converts 2-point play in OT to upset No. 10 LSU
items.description: Quarterback Kenneth Minchey ran for a 2-point conversion in overtime to lift Kentucky to a 35-34 victory over No. 10 LSU on Saturday night.

items.headline: Kentucky QB Minchey scores 2-point conversion in overtime to beat No. 10 LSU 35-34
items.description: — Quarterback Kenneth Minchey ran untouched for a 2-point conversion after C.J. Baxter scored on a 1-yard run to lift Kentucky to a 35-34 overtime victory over No. 10 LSU on Saturday night.

items.headline: How can LSU's defense be a different test for Kentucky?
items.description: Being ranked the second best defense in the FBS, SEC Now's Chris Doering explains how the No. 10 Tigers' defensive force can affect Kenny Minchey and the Kentucky Wildcats.
